site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Nemo Amintaccen Taimako na Kusa da Ku
site.metaDescription: Yi ajiyar amintattun masu taimako na kusa don tsabtace gida, gyare-gyare, kwalliya, kula da lambu, kaura, kula da dabbobi, kula da tsofaffi, koyarwa, da ƙari.
site.hero.body: Yi ajiyar tsabtace gida, gyare-gyare, kwalliya, kula da lambu, taimakon kaura, kula da dabbobi da ƙari daga kasuwa ɗaya ta unguwa.
site.hero.rating: daga maƙwabta 2,300+ · masu taimako 1,200 a kusa
site.hero.review: Na yi ajiyar mai gyara a kan titi cikin minti 10.
site.hero.bookingMeta: Kula da lambu · Asabar 9:00 na safe
site.how.title: Taimako yana nesa da taɓawa uku
site.how.body: Daga "ina buƙatar a yi wannan" zuwa an yi ajiya, ba tare da kiran waya baya-baya, zato, ko kiyasin farashi maras tabbas ba.
site.steps.0.1: Duba amintattun masu taimako na kusa a taswira kai tsaye, an jera su bisa nisa da kima.
site.steps.1.1: Duba bayanan martaba, hidimomi, da farashi a fili kafin ku yanke shawara.
site.steps.2.0: Yi ajiya, hira, ku biya cikin aminci
site.steps.2.1: Aika saƙo, nemi kiyasin farashi, ku biya cikin tsaro a cikin manhajar.
site.helpers.title: Mai da gwanintarku kuɗin shiga na gida
site.helpers.body: Saita sau ɗaya ku fara samun ajiya daga maƙwabta da suke buƙatar daidai abin da kuke yi.
site.helpers.freeTitle: Kyauta ne har abada ga masu taimako
site.helpers.freeBody: Ku riƙe 100% na abin da kuka samu. SwapSpot ba ya karɓar kwamishin, kashi, ko kuɗin neman abokin ciniki.
site.perks.0.1: Jera gwanintarku, hotuna, da yankin aikinku cikin ƴan mintuna.
site.perks.1.1: Kuna da iko kan farashi, tazara, da jadawali.
site.perks.2.0: Karɓi ajiya ku aika kiyasin farashi
site.perks.2.1: Samu buƙatu na kusa ku amsa da kiyasin farashi na musamman.
site.perks.3.0: Gina bita da abokan ciniki masu dawowa
site.perks.3.1: Samu kima da ke mayar da ayyukan farko abokan ciniki na dindindin.
site.categories.title: Duk aikin da ake da shi, akwai mai taimako
site.categories.body: Manyan rukunan hidimomin gida a lokacin ƙaddamarwa, ana ƙara wasu yayin da kowace kasuwa ke girma.
site.trust.title: An gina don a ji lafiya ga ɓangarorin biyu
site.trust.body: Bita na gaske, saƙonni na sirri, da zaɓuɓɓukan da ke bar maƙwabta su mallaki bayanansu.
site.trustItems.0.1: Kima na gaske daga maƙwabta na gaske bayan kowane aiki.
site.trustItems.1.1: Ajiye tattaunawa da kiyasin farashi a wuri ɗaya.
site.trustItems.2.1: Yi wa kowane mai amfani rahoto ko ku toshe shi kowane lokaci.
site.trustItems.3.1: Share asusunku da bayananku a duk lokacin da kuka so.
site.trustItems.4.1: Masu taimako ne ke sarrafa yadda ake nuna wurinsu.
site.waitlist.title: Zazzage SwapSpot yau
site.waitlist.body: Duba masu taimako na kusa kyauta. Yi amfani da izini idan kun shirya aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiya.
site.waitlist.storeCaption: Yanzu yana samuwa a iOS da Android
site.waitlist.noSpam: Zazzage manhajar, ku duba masu taimako, ku fara idan kun shirya.
site.download.title: Zazzage SwapSpot don iOS ko Android
site.download.body: Duba masu taimako na kusa kyauta. Yi amfani da izini idan kun shirya aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiya.
site.download.pointA: Abokan ciniki da masu taimako maraba
site.download.pointB: Dubawa kyauta kafin tuntuɓar mai taimako
site.footer.tagline: Kasuwar unguwa don amintaccen taimako na gida. An yi ta don al'ummomi a faɗin Amurka.
site.footer.bottom: Nemo amintaccen taimako na gida kusa da ku.
site.footer.companyLine: Yana aiki ƙarƙashin USPROJECT LLC · EIN 83-3989558 · New York, Amurka
directory.indexMetaDescription: Duba shafukan hidima na jama'a na SwapSpot bisa rukuni da kasuwar gida. Nemo tsabtace gida, gyare-gyare, kaura, koyarwa, kula da dabbobi, kwalliya, ayyukan ƙwararru, da ƙari.
directory.indexTitle: Hidimomin masu taimako na gida bisa rukuni da kasuwa
directory.indexIntro: An ƙirƙiri waɗannan shafuka daga hidimomin masu taimako da aka wallafa a SwapSpot. Suna taimaka wa abokan ciniki gano samfuran hidima na gaske bisa birni, lambar gidan waya, unguwa, rukuni, farashi, harshe, da kima.
directory.statPages: shafukan rukuni da kasuwa masu aiki
directory.byCountryBody: Kowace hanyar haɗi a ƙasa tana buɗe shafin jama'a. Idan mai taimako ya wallafa sabon yankin aiki, yana bayyana a nan bayan ma'ajiyar shafin ta sabunta.
directory.emptyBody: An gina jerin daga hidimomin masu taimako da aka wallafa. Idan babu hanyoyin haɗi a nan tukuna, ku dawo nan ba da jimawa ba ko ku buɗe manhajar domin duba masu taimako na kusa.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Nemo masu taimako na {categoryLower} a {market}. Kwatanta samfuran hidima na jama'a, yankunan aiki, farashi, harsuna, da kima kafin buɗe SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Duba hidimomin {categoryLower} na gida kusa da {market} ku ci gaba a manhajar SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot na shirya samfuran masu taimako na {categoryLower} a {market}. Buɗe manhajar domin duba masu taimako na kusa, kwatanta yankunan aiki, da neman kiyasin farashi.
directory.pairSummary: Kwatanta samfuran hidimar {categoryLower} na jama'a daga masu taimako na gida kusa da {market}. Yi amfani da manhajar idan kun shirya aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiya.
directory.popularTitle: Abin da mutane za su samu a {market}
directory.popularBody: Waɗannan hidimomi sun fito daga bayanan masu taimako da aka wallafa, ba jerin talla na tsaye ba.
directory.areaTitle: Yankin gida, ba ainihin adireshi ba
directory.areaBody: Shafukan jama'a suna nuna unguwanni, lambobin gidan waya, birane, da tazarar hidima domin abokan ciniki su gano taimako na kusa ba tare da bayyana adireshi na sirri ba.
directory.namesBody: Ana tsara hidimomin masu taimako zuwa laƙabi masu sauƙin bincike, kalmomin gida, da shafukan rukuni domin abokan ciniki su bincika ayyukan da suke buƙata da gaske.
directory.inAppTitle: Hira da ajiya suna cikin manhaja
directory.inAppBody: Shafin yanar gizo yana taimaka wa mutane gano hidimomi. SwapSpot yana ajiye kiyasin farashi, saƙonni, ajiya, bita, da kayan tsaro a cikin manhajar wayar.
directory.faqTitle: Yadda wannan shafin jama'a yake aiki
directory.pairFaq1Q: Zan iya yin ajiyar masu taimako na {categoryLower} a {market} a wannan shafin?
directory.pairFaq1A: Wannan shafin yanar gizo samfurin jama'a ne don gano hidimomi. Zazzage SwapSpot domin aika saƙo ga masu taimako, neman kiyasin farashi, raba ainihin adireshi, da sarrafa ajiya.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Ainihin adireshin masu taimako na jama'a ne?
directory.pairFaq2A: A'a. SwapSpot yana nuna kusan yankunan hidima kamar lambobin gidan waya, unguwanni, birane, ko tazara. Ainihin adireshi yana nan a sirri kuma ana iya raba shi a hira ne kawai idan ɓangarorin biyu sun shirya.
directory.pairFaq3Q: Shin masu taimako suna biyan SwapSpot kwamishin?
directory.pairFaq3A: A'a. Masu taimako za su iya ƙirƙirar bayanin martaba su jera hidimomi ba tare da kwamishin ko kashi na SwapSpot ba. Abokan ciniki suna biyan kuɗin samun dama idan suna son aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiya.
directory.pairListDescription: Samfuran jama'a na hidimomin {categoryLower} da ake samu ta SwapSpot a {market}.
directory.cardsEmptyTitle: Duba masu taimako na {categoryLower} a manhajar
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot yana buɗe bayanan masu taimako na gida bisa kasuwa. Zazzage manhajar domin ganin hidimomi na kusa, kwatanta farashi, da aika saƙo ga masu taimako idan kun shirya.
directory.cardsTitle: Samfuran masu taimako na {categoryLower} na gaske
directory.cardsBody: Kwatanta hidimomi, farashi, yankuna, harsuna, kima, da gogewar masu taimako kusa da {market}. Ainihin adireshi da tuntuɓa kai tsaye suna nan a cikin SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Duba samfurin wannan hidima a SwapSpot, sannan ku buɗe manhajar domin aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiya.
directory.helperDescription: {name} yana ba da {services} ta SwapSpot a kusa da {markets}. Kwatanta samfuran hidima na jama'a, farashi, harsuna, kima, da yankunan hidima kafin buɗe manhajar.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} yana ba da {services} ta SwapSpot. Kwatanta samfuran hidima na jama'a, farashi, harsuna, kima, da yankunan hidima kafin buɗe manhajar.
directory.helperTagline: Mai taimako na {category} a kusa da {market}
directory.previewBody: Kwatanta hidimomi a nan, sannan ku aika saƙo ku yi ajiya a cikin manhajar.
directory.noCommissionBody: Masu taimako suna riƙe kuɗin ayyukansu. SwapSpot ba ya ɗaukar kashi ko kwamishin daga aikin mai taimako.
directory.servicesTitle: Abin da {name} zai iya taimakawa da shi
directory.servicesBody: Waɗannan samfuran hidima ne da aka wallafa daga SwapSpot. Farashi na iya zama tsayayye, na awa, farawa daga, ko idan an nema, bisa ga aikin.
directory.serviceFallback: Buɗe SwapSpot domin ganin wannan hidima, neman bayani, da tabbatar da iyakar aiki kafin yin ajiya.
directory.areasTitle: An gina don gano na gida
directory.areasBody: Shafukan masu taimako na jama'a suna ba injunan bincike da abokan ciniki isasshen bayani: sunayen hidima, unguwanni, birane, kusan yankuna, da alamomin harshe. Ainihin bayanan tuntuɓa suna nan a cikin SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Aika saƙo, nemi kiyasin farashi, ku yi ajiya tare da kayan sirri.
directory.helperFaq1A: Buɗe SwapSpot domin aika wa mai taimako saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, raba cikakkun bayanan aiki, da sarrafa ajiya cikin aminci a cikin manhajar.
directory.helperFaq2A: A'a. Shafukan jama'a suna nuna kusan yankunan hidima kamar unguwanni, birane, lambobin gidan waya, ko tazara. Ainihin adireshi yana nan a sirri har sai masu amfani sun raba shi a hira.
directory.helperFaq3Q: Shin SwapSpot yana ɗaukar kwamishin daga masu taimako?
directory.helperFaq3A: A'a. Masu taimako za su iya jera hidimomi ba tare da SwapSpot ya ɗauki kwamishin ko kashi daga kuɗin ayyukansu ba.
directory.categoryMetaTitle: {category} Kusa da Ku - Amintattun Masu Taimako na Gida
directory.categoryMetaDescription: Yi ajiyar amintattun masu taimako na {categoryLower} na gida kusa da ku a SwapSpot. Kwatanta bayanan martaba, farashi, da bita.
directory.categoryTitle: Masu taimako na {category} kusa da ku
directory.categoryBody: Bincika hidimomin {categoryLower} daga masu taimako na gida a yankinku.
directory.cityMetaDescription: Nemo amintattun masu taimako na gida a {city} don tsabtace gida, gyare-gyare, kula da lambu, kula da dabbobi, da ƙari.
directory.cityBody: Yi ajiyar masu taimako na kusa don tsabtace gida, gyare-gyare, kula da lambu, kaura, kula da dabbobi, kula da tsofaffi, koyarwa, da ƙari. SwapSpot yana taimaka wa maƙwabta kwatanta hidimomi, farashi, bita, da samuwa kafin su yi ajiya.
directory.cityCategoryBody: Kwatanta amintattun masu taimako na gida kusa da ku
directory.helpersMetaTitle: Zama Mai Taimako - Samu Kuɗi a Gida
directory.helpersMetaDescription: Mai da gwanintarku kuɗin shiga na gida a SwapSpot. Ƙirƙiri bayanin mai taimako kyauta, saita farashi da lokutan samuwa, ku samu ajiya daga abokan ciniki na kusa.
pricing.title: Duba kyauta. Yi amfani da izini idan kun shirya yin aiki.
pricing.body: Abokan ciniki za su iya bincika rukunai su kwatanta masu taimako ba tare da biya ba. Ana buƙatar izini domin aika saƙo, neman kiyasin farashi, ko yin ajiyar mai taimako.
pricing.freeBody: Duba rukunai, samfuran masu taimako, yankunan hidima, da alamomin amana na asali kafin zaɓar izini.
pricing.plans.0.name: Izinin Yini
pricing.plans.0.note: Ya fi dacewa da aiki ɗaya, taimakon gaggawa, ko gwada SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.0.features.0: Aika wa masu taimako saƙo na yini
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Ya fi dacewa da buƙatun gida, iyali, haya, ko kasuwanci na yau da kullum.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Aika saƙo da neman kiyasin farashi a kowane lokaci
pricing.plans.1.features.2: Ya fi riba bayan kwanaki 5 masu aiki
passPrice.seeStore: Duba farashin yanzu a App Store ko Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Farashin tunani ne. App Store ko Google Play ne ke nuna farashin ƙarshe.
passPrice.footnote: App Store ko Google Play na nuna farashin gida na ƙarshe da haraji kafin sayayya.
staticPages.intro: Wannan shafin yana nan da harshen da kuka zaɓa. Don tambayoyi na shari'a ko na asusu, ku tuntuɓi hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Cikakkiyar ajiya, daga farko zuwa ƙarshe
appPreview.mapBody: Masu taimako 12 cikin mil 2, kai tsaye.
appPreview.messageA: Barka! Za ku iya tsabtace ɗaki 2 a ranar Asabar?
appPreview.messageB: Eh! Ina aika kiyasin farashi yanzu.
forClients.title: Kammala aiki ba tare da bin mutane ba
forClients.body: Buɗe manhajar, duba wanda ke kusa, kwatanta bayanai na gaske, aika saƙo a cikin SwapSpot, ku yi ajiya idan kun gamsu.
forClients.cards.0.1: Bincika bisa rukuni, nisa, kima, da samuwa.
forClients.cards.1.1: Duba bayanan martaba, farashi, bita, hotuna, da hidimomi.
forClients.cards.2.1: Yi tambayoyi, tabbatar da bayanai, ku tsara kiyasin farashi.
forClients.cards.3.1: Yi amfani da bita, rahotanni, toshewa, da kayan sarrafa asusu idan an buƙata.
cookieConsent.title: Zaɓukan sirrinku
cookieConsent.body: Muna amfani da kukis na Google Analytics domin fahimtar ziyara da inganta SwapSpot. Kuna iya karɓa ko ƙin kukis na bincike na zaɓi.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot yana komawa sababbin sabar. Na kusan awa ɗaya, shiga, sake saita kalmar sirri da canje-canjen asusu na iya rashin aiki. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa nan gaba kaɗan.
reset.title: Sake saita kalmar sirrinku
reset.intro: Zaɓi sabuwar kalmar sirri, sannan ku shiga manhajar SwapSpot da imel ɗinku da sabuwar kalmar sirri.
reset.mismatch: Kalmomin sirri ba su yi daidai ba.
reset.done: An canja kalmar sirrinku. Buɗe manhajar SwapSpot ku shiga.
reset.invalid: Wannan hanyar sake saitawa ba ta da inganci ko ta ƙare. Nemi sabuwa daga manhajar.
reset.openLink: Buɗe hanyar sake saitawa daga imel ɗinku domin ci gaba.
reset.unavailable: Sake saita kalmar sirri ba ya samuwa a wannan shafin tukuna.
